decisions.reason: Using separate referral and no-referral mint-success messages does not change tipping options, transfer behavior, or disclosure.

The source does not change ETH-funded mint execution.
The success-message variant decision does not affect exact-output swapping or excess-ETH refunds.
Separate referral and no-referral success messages do not change payment-currency disclosure or method selection.
The modal messages describe referral outcomes but do not change ticket issuance, crediting, counters, or accounting surfaces.
The source distinguishes feedback shown for no-referral mints but does not change commission amount, eligibility, or random recipient allocation.
